[[2021 Maui Invitational Tournament|Maui Invitational]] champions |tourney = [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}} [[File:Welsh-Ryan (51829598303).jpg|thumb|right|During the game at [[2021–22 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]]]] The '''2021–22 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Badgers were led by seventh-year head coach [[Greg Gard]] and played their home games at the [[Kohl Center]] in [[Madison, Wisconsin]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 25–8, 15–5 in [[2021–22 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to earn a share of the regular season championship. As the No. 2 seed in the [[2022 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they lost [[2021–22 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 3 seed in the Midwest region, the school's 26th trip to the tournament. They defeated [[2021–22 Colgate Raiders men's basketball team|Colgate]] in the First Round before being upset by No. 11 seed [[2021–22 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] in the Second Round. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Badgers]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 18–13, 10–10 in [[2020–21 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish tied for sixth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Penn State Nittany Lions basketball team|Penn State]] in the second round of the [[2021 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]],{{Cite web|date=2021-03-12|title=Penn State Hoops Falls In Big Ten tournament To Wisconsin 75-74 Despite Heroic Comeback|url=https://onwardstate.com/2021/03/11/penn-state-hoops-falls-in-big-ten-tournament-to-wisconsin-75-74-despite-heroic-comeback/|access-date=2021-07-19|website=Onward State|language=en-US}} but lost to [[2020–21 Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball team|Iowa]] in the quarterfinals.{{Cite web|last=Brew|first=Tom|title=Big Ten: Iowa Beats Wisconsin Again, Will Meet Illinois in Semifinals|url=https://www.si.com/college/indiana/basketball/big-ten-tournament-iowa-beats-wisconsin-again-advances-to-semifinals|access-date=2021-07-19|website=Sports Illustrated|language=en}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], their 25th trip to the NCAA Tournament, as the No. 9 seed in the South region.{{Cite web|last=Marotta|first=Karley|date=2021-03-14|title=Wisconsin receives 9 seed and will play North Carolina in the first round of the NCAA Tournament|url=https://wkow.com/2021/03/14/wisconsin-receives-9-seed-and-will-play-north-carolina-in-the-first-round-of-the-ncaa-tournament/|access-date=2021-07-19|website=WKOW|language=en-US}} The Badgers defeated [[2020–21 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]]{{Cite web|title=Wisconsin vs. North Carolina - Game Recap - March 19, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401310911|access-date=2021-07-19|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} in the First Round before losing to eventual [[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|National champion]] [[2020–21 Baylor Bears men's basketball team|Baylor]] in the Second Round.{{Cite web|title=Wisconsin vs. Baylor -
